recitation.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِيْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ

transliteration.id: bismillaahil ladzii laa ilaaha illaa huwa
transliteration.en: bismillaahil ladzii laa ilaaha illaa huwa

translation.id: Dengan nama Allah yang tiada Tuhan selain-Nya
translation.en: In the name of Allah, besides whom there is no deity.
